name: Shinohara Mizuho
source:
Mizuho is polite and firm, perhaps because she was raised by a mother who is passionate about education. She has a younger sister who is planning to enter Momogiri Academy next year. 
Mizuho recently saw that her friend's parents got divorced. This occurence made her decide she doesn't care if she has a mediocre future as long as she has good friends. In the future she also wants to start her own family.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
